title: Air for One Diver. There Were Two.

lines.text: Air for one diver to get out. There were two.
So one stayed behind, inside the rock.
Mallorca, Spain. April 2017. The cave of Sa Piqueta.
Xisco Gràcia and Guillem Mascaró were mapping it.
Their guideline broke. Their gas ran low.
Gràcia gave his partner his remaining gas and sent him for help.
Then he waited alone in an air pocket, about 900 metres in.
Fresh water to drink. Almost no light. Air thick with carbon dioxide.
Hours went by. He began to believe his partner hadn't made it.
Above him, rescuers tried to drill down through the rock. It failed.
Divers tried to swim in. The water was too murky.
The bad air made him hallucinate.
Then, around hour 60, a light rose through the water.
Rescue divers had found him. Alive.
His partner had made it out, and raised the alarm.
Air for one diver to get out. Both came home.

shots.description: COLD OPEN, frame 1 already moving. Murky flooded passage, brown-green water. Two divers hang face to face over a silt floor, torch cones crossing. Between them a cut guideline end drifts slack. One diver taps his pressure gauge (gauge face reads generic low, no number).
shots.camera: Slow push-in 35 mm at mid-water between the two divers, handheld drift (amp 0.02); rack from gauge to the slack line.
characters: diver_A Gràcia (yellow fins, back-mounted twins, helmet torch)
shots.lighting: Two warm-white torch spots (22 deg) cutting a dense brown volume; no ambient.

shots.description: A head and helmet torch break the black water surface inside a low rock dome. Ripples spread; drips fall from the ceiling; breath vapour in the torch beam. Nothing else: rock, water, one light.
shots.camera: Water-level 28 mm, lens half an inch above the surface, slow pull-back revealing how small the dome is.
shots.lighting: Helmet torch only; warm bounce off wet rock; everything outside the dome black.

shots.description: Pattern interrupt. Stylised map card of Mallorca (land blob on grid). Route line draws from Palma to the east side; pin drops near Manacor.
shots.camera: Overlay card over a dark, slow-drifting silt background; card scales 0.95 → 1.0.

shots.description: Rewind. Clearer teal water: the two divers swim side by side along a white survey line; one writes on a slate, the other reels line. Name cards pop beside each diver.
shots.camera: Side-tracking 28 mm alongside the divers, slow.
shots.lighting: Two torch cones in clearer water; faint cyan ambient.

shots.description: The line snaps at a sharp rock edge; the loose end whips away into a rising silt cloud and the water turns brown. Cut-in: a generic pressure gauge needle sinks toward the red.
shots.camera: Quick push onto the snapping line (35 mm), then insert 50 mm on the gauge.
shots.lighting: Torch cones fragmenting in silt; water goes teal → brown.

shots.description: Close two-shot: yellow-fin diver unclips a cylinder and pushes it into the orange-fin diver's hands. The orange-fin diver turns and swims away; his torch shrinks into the brown water until it is a dot, then gone.
shots.camera: Tight 40 mm over Gràcia's shoulder; hold as the other torch recedes (focus stays on the receding light).
shots.lighting: Gràcia's torch on the handover; the receding torch is the only other light.

shots.description: Schematic side-section: entrance pool at left, a long flooded passage, a small dome of air far right. Orange dot travels left toward the entrance; cyan dot rises into the dome and stops. A dotted ruler along the passage counts the distance.
shots.camera: Locked diagram; slow pan right-to-left following the orange dot, then snap back to the cyan dot.
shots.lighting: Graphic; black background, cyan rock outline, air dome filled pale grey.

shots.description: Gràcia sits on a rock ledge at the water's edge, helmet torch dimmed to a faint glow. He cups water to his mouth. The air in the beam is hazy and slow; then the torch clicks off and the frame drops to near-black (≤1 s), only drips audible.
shots.camera: Medium 35 mm from across the water, slow push; hold through the blackout.
characters: diver_A Gràcia (seated, mask pushed up, faceless silhouette)
shots.lighting: Dim torch (energy keyed 1500 → 200 → 0); faint cyan rim on wet rock so the frame is never pure black for > 1 s.

shots.description: MID-POINT TURN. Near-black dome. Every second, the torch clicks on for a beat, sweeps the empty water where his partner left, and clicks off. The water stays flat. No light comes.
shots.camera: POV from the ledge, 24 mm, static between flashes; tiny drift.
shots.lighting: Strobe-like torch flashes (on 0.4 s / off 0.6 s) — no faster than 2 Hz (photosensitivity).

shots.description: Night on the dry scrub above the cave: a simple drill tower prop with two work lights and a generator. Camera tilts down through the ground into a schematic cut-away: the drill bore descends, stops short; the air dome sits below it, unreached.
shots.camera: 28 mm crane down from the rig, transition through the ground plane into the 2.5D section (match on the bore line).
shots.lighting: Sodium-orange work lights, blue night sky; section is graphic.

shots.description: Two rescue divers (white fins) enter the passage; their torches stop dead a metre ahead in brown water. One holds a hand up to his mask; the hand vanishes in the murk.
shots.camera: From behind the rescuers, 24 mm; slow push that gains nothing (the frame stays brown).
shots.lighting: Torch cones that turn into a flat brown glow.

shots.description: Inside the dome, the rock walls seem to breathe (slow scale wobble); faint soft glows pulse under the water and fade before they resolve. Abstract, no figures.
shots.camera: Slow 360-deg rotation from the centre of the dome, 20 mm, slight lens breathing.
shots.lighting: Low cyan glows under the surface pulsing (slow, ≤1 Hz) then dying.

shots.description: From the ledge: under the black water, a single white glow grows, sharpening into a torch beam pointed up. Ripples lit from below.
shots.camera: Low 35 mm aimed at the water, slow push-in; the glow fills the lower third.
shots.lighting: One underwater spot (rescuer torch) rising; caustic ripples on the dome ceiling.

shots.description: A rescuer's helmet and torch break the surface: same composition as S02 (head at the waterline, ripples), but now the torch faces Gràcia on the ledge.
shots.camera: Mirror of S02 framing, 28 mm water-level, quick push.
shots.lighting: Two torches now; the dome is lit for the first time.

shots.description: Wide: two rescuers in the water beside the ledge, one passing a regulator up to Gràcia. All three torches up; the dome finally visible: wet rock, a tiny ledge, the flat lake.
shots.camera: Wide 20 mm from the far side of the dome, slow crane up.

shots.description: Reveal. Night at the cave entrance on the surface: emergency vehicle lights (generic blue/amber, no markings) on rock and scrub; a lone figure in a wetsuit (orange fin in hand) stands at the entrance watching the water.
shots.camera: Low 28 mm from behind the figure, slow dolly-in.
characters: figure Mascaró (silhouette, wetsuit, orange fin in hand)
shots.lighting: Blue/amber rotating lights (slow, ≤2 Hz), night sky.

shots.description: The empty air bell: still water, the ledge, drips, lit by a single torch beam from below the surface. Last 0.5 s matches the S01/S02 framing so the loop back to 'Air for one diver…' is seamless.
shots.camera: Slow pull-back 28 mm at water level; final frame = S02 composition.

loop_line: Air for one diver to get out. Both came home.
